description: Draft and independent review of a bounded request; document quality and review evidence are agent responsibilities.

responsibilities: Draft only the bounded authorized request using the addressed inputs and report the immutable UTF-8 document.
Revise against attributed returned_findings without expanding the goal or resetting spent allowances; use produced or BLOCK with causal findings.
Independently read the selected addressed immutable document and the original request; do not review your own contribution.
Report a canonical JSON object with verdict, selected document reference and digest, causal findings, evidence and evidence_limits. These are attributed reports, not engine-verified document quality.

Use APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES or BLOCK. Put correction findings in the generic callback findings field as well as the report so the engine attributes them to the revised draft. REVISE is not a declared outcome.
